dataset.name: fdic top500 2026 all sod branches
dataset.description: Complete retained source table with all original fields and records from this file. Retained table: 55,060 source rows and 81 columns.
dataset.units: Source-native, column-specific units; retained official dictionaries and row unit fields govern interpretation.
dataset.notes:
DEPSUMBR is the branch amount. Bank ASSET and other bank fields repeat across branch rows and must not be summed.
55,060 branch records for all 500 selected banks, complete pagination; all 82 documented fields requested.
Source values and disclosure flags are unchanged. Retrieval time does not establish historical public availability.

coverage.identity_rule: CERT identifies insured institution; ID identifies source record; RSSDHCR identifies regulatory parent and must not replace CERT.
coverage.geography_rule: Branch county STCNTYBR only: validated 4/5-digit numeric source code is zero-padded to five in the search index. Native values unchanged; missing/invalid codes are unindexed. STCNTY county names and CNTYNUMB components are not used.
